title: What is Long? What is Round?: 2D and 3D Shapes
seo_title: 2D and 3D Shapes Class 1 Worksheet with Answers (Joyful Mathematics Chapter 2)
standard_code: Class 1, Joyful Mathematics Chapter 2: What is Long? What is Round?
standard_text: Shapes: observing and describing objects that are long, round, flat or curved; solid shapes that roll or slide; circles, triangles, squares and rectangles (summary of NCERT Joyful Mathematics Class 1)
meta_desc: Class 1 What is Long? What is Round? worksheet (Joyful Mathematics Chapter 2): flat and solid shapes, roll or slide, sides and corners, shapes around us. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_big: A ball is round and rolls; a box is flat-faced and slides.
key_sub: Count the sides and corners of a flat shape.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Solid shapes: a ball (sphere) rolls, a box (cuboid) slides, a can (cylinder) rolls and slides.
  • Flat shapes: circle, triangle (3 sides), square and rectangle (4 sides).

Examples

Example

How many sides does a triangle have?

Count the straight sides

Answer: 3

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Calling a long rectangle a squareA square has all 4 sides the same length.
Thinking a box can rollFlat faces slide; round shapes roll.

faq.q: What is the difference between flat and solid shapes?
faq.a: Flat shapes (circle, square) are drawn on paper; solid shapes (ball, box) can be held.
Round shapes such as a ball or the side of a can.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It is flat and round. It has no corners. It is a circle.

items.q: Name this shape.
items.e: It is flat and round. It has no corners. It is a circle. It is small, but it is still a circle.

items.q: What shape is this?
items.e: It has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. It is a triangle.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. It is a triangle. It is upside down, but it is still a triangle.

items.q: Name this shape.
items.e: It has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. It is a triangle. It is turned, but it is still a triangle.

items.q: What shape is this?
items.e: It has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. It is a triangle. A long, thin triangle is still a triangle.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It has 4 sides that are all the same length and 4 square corners. It is a square.

items.q: Name this shape.
items.e: It has 4 sides that are all the same length and 4 square corners. It is a square. It is small, but it is still a square.

items.q: What shape is this?
items.e: It has 4 sides that are all the same length and 4 square corners. It is a square. It is standing on a corner. Some people say “diamond”, but it is still a square.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It has 4 sides that are all the same length and 4 square corners. It is a square. It is turned, but it is still a square.

items.q: What shape is this?
items.e: It is flat and round. It has no corners. It is a circle.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It is flat and round. It has no corners. It is a circle. Colour does not change the name.

items.q: Name this shape.
items.e: It has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. It is a triangle. It is upside down. It is still a triangle.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. It is a triangle. It is turned. It is still a triangle.

items.q: Name this shape.
items.e: It has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. It is a triangle. It points to the side. It is still a triangle.

items.q: What shape is this?
items.e: It has 4 sides. They are all the same length. It is a square. It is small. It is still a square.

items.q: Name this shape.
items.e: It has 4 sides. They are all the same length. It is a square. It stands on a corner. Some people say “diamond”. It is still a square.

items.q: What shape is this?
items.e: It has 4 sides and 4 square corners. 2 sides are long. 2 are short. It is a rectangle.

items.q: Name this shape.
items.e: It has 4 sides and 4 square corners. 2 sides are long. 2 are short. It is a rectangle. It is standing up. It is still a rectangle.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It has 4 sides and 4 square corners. 2 sides are long. 2 are short. It is a rectangle. It is tilted. It is still a rectangle.

items.q: How many sides does this shape have?
items.e: Touch each side once. 1, 2, 3. A triangle has 3 sides.

items.q: How many corners does this shape have?
items.e: Touch each corner once. 1, 2, 3. A triangle has 3 corners.

items.q: How many sides does this shape have?
items.e: Count each side once. 1, 2, 3, 4. A square has 4 sides.

items.q: How many corners does this shape have?
items.e: It stands on a corner. Count all the corners, top and bottom. There are 4.

items.q: How many sides does this shape have?
items.e: Count the long sides and the short sides. 2 + 2 = 4 sides.

items.q: How many corners does this shape have?
items.e: Count each corner once. Do not forget the bottom corners. There are 4.

items.q: How many corners does this shape have?
items.e: A circle is round all the way. It has no corners: 0.

items.q: How many sides does this shape have?
items.e: It is long and thin. Count the sides: 1, 2, 3. It is a triangle.

items.q: How many corners does this shape have?
items.e: It points down. Count the corners: 1, 2, 3.

items.q: How many sides does this shape have?
items.e: It is small and turned. It still has 4 sides.

items.q: What is the red part?
items.e: A side is a straight line on the edge of a shape. The red line is a side.

items.q: What is the red dot on?
items.e: A corner is where 2 sides meet. The red dot is on a corner.

items.q: Which shape has 3 corners?
items.e: B is a triangle. It has 3 corners. The square and the rectangle have 4. The circle has 0.

items.q: Which shape has no corners?
items.e: C is a circle. It is round, so it has no corners.

items.q: Which shape has 4 sides all the same length?
items.e: A is a square. All 4 sides are the same. The rectangles have 2 long and 2 short sides.
D is a rectangle. It has 4 corners. The triangle has 3. The circle and oval have none.

items.q: I have 3 sides and 3 corners. What am I?
items.e: 3 sides and 3 corners make a triangle.

items.q: I have 4 sides. 2 are long. 2 are short. What am I?
items.e: 4 sides with 2 long and 2 short: a rectangle. A square has 4 sides the same.

items.q: Which has more corners?
items.e: The square has 4 corners. The triangle has 3. 4 is more than 3.

items.q: How many corners do they have?
items.e: Count each one. The rectangle has 4 corners. The square has 4 corners.

items.q: What is this 3-D shape called?
items.e: It is solid. All its faces are squares of the same size. It is a cube.

items.q: Name this 3-D shape.
items.e: It is solid. All its faces are squares of the same size. It is a cube. It is turned, but it is still a cube.

items.q: What 3-D shape is this?
items.e: It is solid. All its faces are squares of the same size. It is a cube. It is small, but it is still a cube.

items.q: What is this 3-D shape called?
items.e: It is solid, like a box. Some faces are long rectangles, so it is not a cube. It is a cuboid.

items.q: Name this 3-D shape.
items.e: It is solid, like a box. Some faces are long rectangles, so it is not a cube. It is a cuboid. It is standing on its end, but it is still a cuboid.

items.q: What 3-D shape is this?
items.e: It is solid, like a box. Some faces are long rectangles, so it is not a cube. It is a cuboid. It is turned, but it is still a cuboid.

items.q: What is this 3-D shape called?
items.e: It has a square at the bottom and triangle faces that meet at a point. It is a pyramid.

items.q: Name this 3-D shape.
items.e: It has a square at the bottom and triangle faces that meet at a point. It is a pyramid. It is turned, but it is still a pyramid.
It has a flat circle at each end and a curved side. It is a cylinder.
It has a flat circle at each end and a curved side. It is a cylinder. It is lying on its side, but it is still a cylinder.
It has 1 flat circle and comes to a point. It is a cone.
It has 1 flat circle and comes to a point. It is a cone. It is upside down, but it is still a cone.

items.q: What is the name of this solid shape?
items.e: It is a solid, not flat. All its faces are the same square. It is a cube. A square is a flat shape.

items.q: What is the name of this solid shape?
items.e: It has a flat circle on the top and one on the bottom, with a round side. It is a cylinder.

items.q: What is the name of this solid shape?
items.e: It has 1 flat circle at the bottom and a point at the top. It is a cone. A triangle is flat.

items.q: What is the name of this solid shape?
items.e: It is shaped like a box. Some faces are long rectangles, so it is not a cube. It is a cuboid.

items.q: Which one is a cylinder?
items.e: Solid C has a flat circle on the top and on the bottom. The cone has only 1 circle and a point.

items.q: Which one is a cone?
items.e: Picture A has a point at the top and a circle at the bottom. One picture is a flat triangle, not a solid.

items.q: A can of soup is shaped like a ___.
items.e: A can has a flat circle on the top and the bottom. It is a cylinder.

items.q: An ice cream cone is shaped like a ___.
items.e: It has a point at the bottom and a circle at the top. It is a cone. A triangle is flat.

items.q: Which shape is 3-D (solid)?
items.e: C is a cube. It is solid, so it is 3-D. The others are flat 2-D shapes.
B is a sphere. It is round all over, like a ball, so it is 3-D. The circle is flat.

items.q: Which shape is 3-D (solid)?
items.e: A is a pyramid. It is solid, so it is 3-D. The triangles and the square are flat.
D is a circle. It is flat, so it is 2-D. The others are solid 3-D shapes.
D is a rectangle. It is flat, so it is 2-D. The cuboid looks like a rectangle from the front, but it is solid.
C is a triangle. It is flat, so it is 2-D. The pyramid and the cone are solid.
B is flat and round: a circle. The sphere is round too, but it is solid.
A is round all over, like a ball: a sphere. The circle is flat, so it is not a sphere.

items.q: Which one is a square?
items.e: B is a flat square. The cube has square faces, but it is solid, so it is a cube.
C is solid with square faces: a cube. The squares are flat.
A is a flat triangle. The pyramid and the cone are solid 3-D shapes.
The cube, the cylinder and the sphere are solid: 3 shapes. The circle, the triangle and the square are flat.
The cone, the cuboid, the pyramid and the sphere are solid: 4 shapes. The rectangle and the circle are flat.
The triangle and the square are flat: 2 shapes. The cube, the cylinder and the cone are solid.

items.q: You draw round the yellow face. What shape do you draw?
items.e: Each face of a cube is a flat square. You draw a square. The cube itself is 3-D.

items.q: You draw round the yellow face. What shape do you draw?
items.e: The yellow face has 2 long sides and 2 short sides. It is a rectangle.
The flat ends of a cylinder are circles. You draw a circle. In the picture it looks squashed because we see it from the side.

items.q: You stand this pyramid on paper. You draw round the bottom. What shape do you draw?
items.e: The bottom of this pyramid is a flat square. The sides are triangles, but you draw round the bottom.
The bottom of a cone is a flat circle. A cone looks like a triangle from the side, but it has no triangle faces.

items.q: Which one is a flat 2-D shape?
items.e: A circle is flat, like a drawing on paper. A sphere, a cube and a cone are solid. You can hold them.
A ball is round all over. It is a sphere. A circle is flat.

items.q: This is an orange. What 3-D shape is it?
items.e: An orange is round all over, like a ball. It is a sphere.

items.q: This is a dice. What 3-D shape is it?
items.e: A dice has 6 square faces, all the same size. It is a cube. A square is only one flat face.
A tin has a flat circle at the top and the bottom and a curved side. It is a cylinder.

items.q: This is a cereal box. What 3-D shape is it?
items.e: A cereal box has big faces and thin faces. It is not a cube. It is a cuboid.

items.q: This is a tent. What 3-D shape is it?
items.e: This tent has a square bottom and triangle sides that meet at a point. It is shaped like a pyramid.
A party hat has a round bottom and a point at the top. It is a cone.

items.q: What 3-D shape is a marble?
items.e: A marble is round all over. It is a sphere.

items.q: What 3-D shape is an ice-cream cone?
items.e: It has a circle at the top and a point at the bottom. It is a cone.

items.q: What 3-D shape is a book?
items.e: A book has 6 flat faces. Some are long and some are thin. It is a cuboid.
A circle is flat. A ball is round all over. It is a sphere.
Both are round. The circle is flat. The sphere is solid, like a ball.

items.q: What is different?
items.e: The square is flat. The cube is solid. Each face of the cube is a square.
The cylinder has 2 flat circles. The cone has 1. Both have a circle face. Only the cone has a point.

c: only the cone has a point
items.e: Both are solid and both can roll. The cone comes to a point. The cylinder does not.
The ball is a sphere. It is curved all over, so it rolls. The dice has flat faces. It slides.
A cube has a flat top and a flat bottom. Cubes stack well. A sphere rolls off. A cone has a point.
The bottom of a tin is a flat circle. Imran draws a circle.

items.q: Isha draws round one face of a dice. What shape does she draw?
items.e: A dice is a cube. Each face is a flat square.

items.q: Anika cuts her square sandwich on the line. What shape is each piece?
items.e: The cut goes from corner to corner. Each piece has 3 sides. Each piece is a triangle.
